text:
Maria Nguyen: Kicking off Orpheus (ord-3) region bring-up validation. I'm running the lightweight smoke list now — posting failures here. Anyone oncall can take handoff after 10:30 UTC?

Ezra Patel: I'm here for networking checks. I'll validate BGP, MTU, and the inter-rack routing policies.

Samir Cohen: I'll do GPU pool health and NVLink checks. Quick note: we'll want to keep the initial GPU allocation conservative (25% of nodes) to validate autoscaler behavior.

Maria Nguyen: Run command for cluster health: `rctl cluster health --region ord-3 --quick`

deploy-bot: deploy status: controlplane pods OK (3/3), node-agent 12/12 running, certs issued.

Maria Nguyen: Results: controlplane fine, but one node shows kernel OOM messages during startup. Posting snippet:
```
[syslog] Mar 10 10:08:12 node-7 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4213 (containerd) score 239 or sacrifice child
[syslog] Mar 10 10:08:12 node-7 systemd: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=exited
```

Jen O'Leary: Might be cgroup memory limits too tight. Was the node image using the same kernel config as prod?

Samir Cohen: Looks like `vm.overcommit_memory` set to 0 on that host. I pushed sysctl tweak to 1 and restarted node-agent. Re-run health probe.

Maria Nguyen: Re-run: `rctl node check node-7 --logs --since 5m` -> now stable. GPU driver loaded, nvidia-smi OK.

Ezra Patel: Networking smoke: MTU 9000 validated across the 3 top-of-rack switches. BGP adjacency established to both upstreams. Noticed asymmetric routing to the logging ingest endpoint — traced to missing route in virtual-router-2. I pushed a policy route fix.

deploy-bot: canary workloads deployed: 4 pods; probe results: 4/4 READY; p50 latency 18ms, p95 72ms.

Maria Nguyen: Model-serving quick smoke: push tiny model and run 50 concurrent requests: `make smoke-service TEST_CONN=50 REGION=ord-3`

Samir Cohen: Model smoke run: 50 req/s for 60s -> no OOM, avg throughput 46 rps, p95 latency 220ms (target < 300ms). KV cache warmup observed; caching reduces duplicate prefix load by ~68%.

Ezra Patel: Cost-sanity check: initial spot pool pricing in ord-3 is ~12% higher than baseline region. Recommend setting burst pool to on-demand for first 48h until autoscaler stable.

Maria Nguyen: SLO gate checklist (quick):
- control plane: OK
- node agent: OK
- GPU driver: OK
- networking BGP/MTU: OK (after fix)
- model smoke p95 < 300ms: OK
- infra alarms configured: pending (Jen)

Jen O'Leary: Alarms: created CPU, mem, GPU temp, and kernel OOM alerts in Datadog. Dashboards pinned to ord-3 folder. Alert runbook linked.

Maria Nguyen: Remaining items before handoff:
1) Confirm long-run soak (6h) on canary service with periodic synthetic traffic
2) Validate autoscaler bump behavior under ramp (simulate 3x load)
3) Run security sweep for ECR image policies and KMS access logs

Samir Cohen: I'll run the soak and autoscaler sim. Kickoff in 5m.

sre-oncall: I'm taking handoff at 10:46 UTC. If soak completes without new alerts, I'll mark ord-3 as READY_FOR_TRAFFIC and update the runbook. :thumbsup:

Maria Nguyen: Thanks all — posting final checklist summary in runbooks/orpheus/validation and setting status -> pending final soak. If anything pops, ping me and @sre-oncall.
